name: Quadrant Catering Services
headline: PROVIDING SAFE & TASTY FOOD at AFFORDABLE PRICES
lede: We are a Dubai-based catering company, operating from our Central Kitchen in Dubai Investment Park-1 since 2012.
about: We are a Dubai-based catering company, operating from our Central Kitchen in Dubai Investment Park-1 since 2012. We specialize in providing daily meals, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with a focus on Nepalese, North Indian, and South Indian cuisine. Our services are tailored to meet the needs of factory workers, company employees, and site workers, operating under both B2B and D2C business models.

At Quadrant Catering, we specialize in delivering high-quality, safe, and affordable meals tailored to the needs of Dubai’s workforce. Since 2012, our HACCP-certified kitchen has crafted delicious Nepalese, North Indian, and South Indian cuisine, offering both contract-based services and direct meal deliveries to companies and individuals.
